text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The infant's history of prematurity, placental insufficiency, maternal non-immunity to rubella, and current presentation of apnea and anemia are highly suggestive of congenital rubella infection. REQUEST IMAGES: Echocardiogram to assess for Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA) or Pulmonary Stenosis.
